changelog:
- Major refactor: removed all Node.js script files and the package-lock.json.
- All operational details and examples are now documented in SKILL.md—manual workflows, commands, and data formats are included.
- Skill usage workflows (add/view/delete/convert/sync) are now intended to be handled via documented external commands and file operations rather than internal scripts.
